audited.verdict: PASS (zh-CN after C1). '#' kept before {name}; fr has U+202F before '?' (C4, fixed at a128abe184); es uses ¿…?; zh-CN space removed at 45d27bbc32 (C1).

audited.en: Members keep read access to its history, but nobody can post. You can unarchive it at any time.
audited.target: सदस्य इसका इतिहास पढ़ सकते रहेंगे, पर कोई संदेश नहीं भेज सकेगा। आप किसी भी समय इसे आर्काइव से निकाल सकते हैं।
audited.verdict: PASS. Covers all three consequences: read access stays, nobody can post, reversible at any time.

audited.verdict: PASS. Byte-identical to menu.archive in every locale, as the context requires.

audited.verdict: PASS (zh-CN after C1). Word order adapted; {name} and {date} each kept once. ru 'архивировал(а)' is the accepted gender-neutral UI form for an unknown archiver.

audited.target: यह चैनल {date} को आर्काइव किया गया।
audited.verdict: PASS (zh-CN after C1).

audited.verdict: PASS.

audited.verdict: PASS. Reads as the inverse of archive (désarchiver / desarchivar / 取消归档 / вернуть из архива / bỏ lưu trữ / آرکائیو سے نکالیں / आर्काइव से निकालें).

audited.verdict: PASS (fr after C4: U+202F before ':'). Says it is archived and that nobody can post.

audited.target: क्या #{name} को हमेशा के लिए हटाना है?
audited.verdict: PASS (zh-CN after C1, fr after C4: U+202F before '?').

audited.en: All messages, threads, reactions and attachments in this channel will be erased. This can’t be undone, and nothing can be recovered.
audited.target: इस चैनल के सभी संदेश, थ्रेड, प्रतिक्रियाएँ और अटैचमेंट मिटा दिए जाएँगे। यह कार्रवाई वापस नहीं हो सकती और कुछ भी वापस नहीं मिलेगा।
audited.verdict: PASS (vi, ur, hi after C2/C3). Names messages, threads, reactions and attachments, plus 'cannot be undone' and 'nothing recoverable', without softening. Thread/reaction terms now match the Team Bridge catalogue (fil/hilo/讨论串/обсуждения~ветка*/luồng trò chuyện/تھریڈز/थ्रेड; réactions/reacciones/表情回应/реакции/cảm xúc/ردعمل/प्रतिक्रियाएँ). *ru 'обсуждения' rather than 'ветки' (ui.teamBridge.replies.title): acceptable in a list of erased content, INFO O2.

audited.en: You can manage this archived channel, but you were never a member, so its messages aren’t available to you.
audited.target: आप इस आर्काइव चैनल को प्रबंधित कर सकते हैं, पर आप कभी इसके सदस्य नहीं रहे, इसलिए इसके संदेश आपके लिए उपलब्ध नहीं हैं।

audited.en: This channel wasn’t found. It may already be deleted, or you may no longer be allowed to delete it. Refresh the list to check.
audited.target: यह चैनल नहीं मिला। हो सकता है यह पहले ही हटाया जा चुका हो, या अब आपको इसे हटाने की अनुमति न हो। जाँचने के लिए सूची रीफ़्रेश करें।
audited.verdict: PASS. Hedges both possibilities in every locale (peut-être / es posible / 可能 / возможно / có thể / ممکن ہے / हो सकता है); never states deletion or refusal as fact; asks for a refresh.

audited.verdict: PASS.

audited.verdict: PASS (zh-CN after C1). Says both that it failed and that the channel is back in the sidebar; sidebar term matches the catalogue. ur prefixes چینل so the sentence opens in RTL script.

resolved_findings.issue: Anusvara हटाएं/जाएंगे where the guide and catalogue use chandrabindu हटाएँ/जाएँगे.
resolved_findings.verification: Re-read at reviewed_head; the value equals 'now', and the mechanical checks re-ran clean.

independence: Independent auditor (reviewer role). This run wrote none of the audited strings and edited no catalogue byte; remediation commits were authored by a separate translator subagent. This run wrote only this receipt, the per-locale evidence records, and (via ledger-assemble.mjs) the ledger rows.
limitations: No rendered frame, pseudo-localization or RTL layout inspection (this auditor session has no browser tool). ur bidi safety was judged from the strings: no manual controls, plus the render layer's FSI/PDI isolation and dir handling (src/i18n/direction.ts, use-document-direction.ts).
